content:
name: CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build_test:
    name: Build & Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Update npm
        run: npm install -g npm@11.11.1

      - run: npm ci
      - name: test
        run: npm run test
